Commentary.Commentary: MS DHON collects the trophy and the rest of the team join him and celebrate the victory. The ODI series is done and dusted but we have a 3-match T20I series with Zimbabwe at this same venue from 18th June, 2016 at 1630 IST. We look further for your company and till then it's goodbye from us.

Man of the match and series, KL RAHUL says that he has the skills and it has been a very good time for him in the recent past. Credits his bowlers for restricting the opposition to a low total which allowed him to stay calm and bat well. Further says that he is enjoying batting and is just thinking of the upcoming T20Is and not the West Indies tour.

MS DHONI credits his young team as they executed their plans very well. He is happy with his bowling department as they were brilliant with the ball. Ends by saying that he will take break after this tour as he wants to spend some quality time with his family.

GRAEME CREMER says that he is disappointed as their plan was to score 240-plus runs but couldn't put the desired total on the board. Adds that they failed to take wickets and that built the pressure on them. Ends by saying that it will be a good track for the upcoming T20I games.

Once again the opening pair played brilliant knocks as both Rahul and Fazal scored their maiden fifties respectively. The batsmen were cautious in batting and didn't give other batsmen the opportunity to bat. Zimbabwean bowlers were not poor in their lengths but failed to provide a breakthrough. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Another clinical win for team India as they beat Zimbabwe in this final ODI and book their first whitewash in the ODI format under the captaincy of Dhoni away from home. Without any doubt, the young lads were outstanding with both bat and ball and won the heart of their captain. Earlier in the match, the visitors bowled out the home team to a low total with Bumrah being the pick of the bowlers. 124 was never a difficult task for the away side as they chased it before the 22nd over.
